crossRefs.note: You shall be blessed when you come in, and you shall be blessed when you go out.
You will be cursed when you come in, and you will be cursed when you go out.
In times past, when Saul was king over us, it was you who led Israel out and in. Yahweh said to you, ‘You will be…
Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river Ahava, that we might humble ourselves before our God, to seek from him a…
Then we departed from the river Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go to Jerusalem. The hand of our God…
that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.
In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow let’s go into this city, and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.”
Blessed be Yahweh’s name, from this time forward and forever more.
but we will bless Yah, from this time forward and forever more. Praise Yah!

translations.web: Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
translations.bsb: The LORD will watch over your coming and going, both now and forevermore.
translations.kjv: The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
translations.asv: Jehovah will keep thy going out and thy coming in From this time forth and for evermore. Psalm 122 A Song of Ascents; of David.
